'''Arndt von Haeseler''' (born 28 February 1959) is a German [[bioinformatics|bioinformatician]] and [[evolutionary biology|evolutionary biologist]]. He is the scientific director of the [[Max F. Perutz Laboratories]] at the [[Vienna Biocenter]] and a professor of bioinformatics at the [[University of Vienna]] and the [[Medical University of Vienna]].

== Education ==
Arndt von Haeseler obtained a doctorate in mathematics from [[Bielefeld University]] in 1988 under the supervision of [[Andreas Dress]] and Hans-Georg Carstens.<ref name="Inaugural">{{cite web | title=Prof. von Haeseler hält seine Antrittsvorlesung an der VUW | website=Veterinärmedizinische Universität Wien| language = de | url=https://www.vetmeduni.ac.at/fileadmin/_migrated/content_uploads/PA_Professur_Bioinformatik.pdf}}</ref><ref name="MGP">{{mathgenealogy|id=24675|name=Arndt von Haeseler}}</ref> He [[habilitation|habilitated]] in 1994 at the Department of Zoology of [[LMU Munich]],<ref name="Inaugural" /> where he remained as a lecturer until 1998.<ref name="ACSD2016" />

== Research and career ==
From 1998 until 2001, von Haeseler was a group leader at the [[Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology]] in [[Leipzig]].<ref name="ACSD2016" /> From 2001 until 2005, he was professor of bioinformatics at the [[University of Düsseldorf]].<ref name="Inaugural" /> He was a group leader in bioinformatics at [[Forschungszentrum Jülich]].<ref name="ACSD2016" /> In 2005, he joined the [[Max F. Perutz Laboratories]] (MFPL) in Vienna, where he leads the Center for Integrative Bioinformatics Vienna (CIBIV).<ref name="Inaugural" />  He is a professor of bioinformatics at the [[University of Vienna]] and the [[Medical University of Vienna]].<ref name="MFPLHome">{{cite web | title=Organisation | website=Max F. Perutz Laboratories | url=https://www.mfpl.ac.at/about-us/organisation.html | access-date=2018-02-11}}</ref> From 2017 to 2020, he was the scientific director of the MFPL (since 2019 Max Perutz Labs).<ref name="MFPLHome" /><ref>{{cite web | title=History of the Max Perutz Labs | website=Home | url=https://www.maxperutzlabs.ac.at/about/history | access-date=2023-05-30}}</ref> At the University Vienna, he was the dean of the Center for Molecular Biology.<ref name="Zentrum für molekulare Biologie (ZMB)">{{cite web | title=Center for molecular biology | website=Zentrum für molekulare Biologie (ZMB) | url=http://zmb.univie.ac.at/en/?gf_page=upload | access-date=2018-02-11}}</ref> At the Medical University of Vienna, he was the head of the Department for Medical Biochemistry.<ref name="MedicalVienna">{{cite web | last=Vienna | first=Medical University of | title=Zentrum für Medizinische Biochemie | website=Medical University of Vienna | url=https://www.meduniwien.ac.at/web/en/about-us/organisation/medical-science-divisions/department-for-medical-biochemistry/ | access-date=2018-02-17}}</ref>

His research focuses on developing computational methods for the reconstruction of [[phylogenetic tree]]s.<ref name="ACSD2016">{{cite web | title=Arndt von Haeseler – Austrian Computer Science Day 2016 | website=Austrian Computer Science Day 2016 | url=http://acsd2016.jku.at/?speaker=arndt-von-haeseler | access-date=2018-02-17}}</ref> He co-authored the [[phylogenetics]] software packages [[Treefinder|TREEFINDER]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=TREEFINDER |url=https://www.treefinder.de/ |access-date=2024-06-22 |website=www.treefinder.de}}</ref> [[Tree puzzle|TREE-PUZZLE]],<ref name="Schmidt Strimmer Vingron Haeseler 2002 pp. 502–504">{{cite journal | last1=Schmidt | first1=Heiko A. | last2=Strimmer | first2=Korbinian | last3=Vingron | first3=Martin | last4=Haeseler | first4=von | successor, [[IQ-TREE]].<ref name="Nguyen Schmidt Haeseler Minh 2014 pp. 268–274">{{cite journal | last1=Nguyen | first1=Lam-Tung | last2=Schmidt | first2=Heiko A. | last3=Haeseler | first3=von | date=2014-11-03 | issn=0737-4038 | doi=10.1093/molbev/msu300 | pmid=25371430 | pages=268–274 | url= | pmc=4271533 }}</ref><ref name="Trifinopoulos Nguyen von Haeseler Minh 2016 pp. W232–W235">{{cite journal | last1=Trifinopoulos | first1=Jana | last2=Nguyen | first2=Lam-Tung | last3=von Haeseler | first3=Arndt | last4=Minh | first4=Bui Quang | title=W-IQ-TREE: a fast online phylogenetic tool for maximum likelihood analysis | journal=Nucleic Acids Research | volume=44 | issue=W1 | date=2016-04-15 | issn=0305-1048 | doi=10.1093/nar/gkw256 | pmid=27084950 | pmc=4987875 | pages=W232–W235 | He sits on the editorial boards of ''[[Molecular Biology and Evolution]]'' and ''[[BMC Evolutionary Biology]]''.<ref name="ÖAW" /><ref name="BMC Evolutionary Biology">{{cite web | title=BMC Evolutionary Biology | website=BMC Evolutionary Biology | url=https://bmcevolbiol.biomedcentral.com/about/editorial-board/editor-profiles | access-date=2018-02-16}}</ref><ref name="Oxford Academic">{{cite web | title=Editorial Board - Molecular Biology and Evolution | website=Oxford Academic | url=https://academic.oup.com/mbe/pages/Editorial_Board | access-date=2018-02-16}}</ref>

=== Awards and honours ===
In 2021, 2022 and 2023, Arndt von Haeseler was awarded "Highly Cited Researcher".
<ref name="Univie2023">{{cite web | title=Elf 'Highly Cited Researchers' an der Universität Wien | website=University of Vienna | url=https://medienportal.univie.ac.at/media/aktuelle-pressemeldungen/detailansicht/artikel/elf-highly-cited-researchers-an-der-universitaet-wien-1/ | access-date=2024-09-04}}</ref><ref name="HighlyCited2023">{{cite web | title=Highly Cited Researchers 2023 | website=Web of Science | url=https://recognition.webofscience.com/awards/highly-cited/2023/ | access-date=2024-09-04}}</ref><ref name="Univie">{{cite web | title=Ten highly cited researchers at the University of Vienna | website=University of Vienna | url=https://medienportal.univie.ac.at/en/media/recent-press-releases/detailansicht-en/artikel/ten-highly-cited-researchers-at-the-university-of-vienna/ | access-date=2023-05-30}}</ref><ref name="HighlyCited2022">{{cite web | title=Highly Cited Researchers 2022 | website=Web of Science | url=https://recognition.webofscience.com/awards/highly-cited/2022/ | access-date=2023-05-30}}</ref><ref name="HighlyCited2021">{{cite web | title=Highly Cited Researchers 2021 | website=Web of Science | url=https://recognition.webofscience.com/awards/highly-cited/2021/ | access-date=2023-05-30}}</ref>

In 2015, von Haeseler was elected as a corresponding member of the mathematics and science class of the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="ÖAW">{{cite web | title=ÖAW Mitglieder Detail | website=Österreichische Akademie der Wissenschaften | url=https://www.oeaw.ac.at/m/von-haeseler-arndt/ | language=de | access-date=2018-02-16}}</ref><ref name="Academy2015">{{cite web | title=Three MFPL group leaders elected as members of the Austrian Academy of Sciences ÖAW | website=Home | date=2015-10-15 | url=http://www.mfpl.ac.at/about-us/news/article/news-detail/three-mfpl-group-leaders-elected-as-members-of-the-austrian-academy-of-sciences-oeaw.html | access-date=2018-02-16}}</ref>

Since 1999, he holds an [[Honorary title (academic)|honorary professorship]] in [[theoretical biology]] at the [[University of Leipzig]].<ref name="ÖAW" /><ref name="Leipzig">{{cite web | title=Bericht des Rektoratskollegiums 1999/2000 | website=University of Leipzig | language=de | url=https://www.uni-leipzig.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Service/oeffentlichkeitsarbeit/Jahresberichte/jahresbericht_2000.pdf }}{{Dead link|date=June 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
